Name: path_look_ahead
"Description": "Defines how far along the global path the planner should look for calculating obstacle avoidance and comfort planning."

Name: vehicle_width
"Description": "The width of the vehicle in meters."

Name: use_global_path
column4: use the global path published by the global path node as the desired centerline. If false
column5: use the user-defined input waypoints as the desired centerline."

Name: num_paths
"Description": "The number of candidate paths to generate. More paths will result in a more optimal solution

Name: max_steer_angle
"Description": "The maximum desired steering angle of the vehicle

Name: output_path_step
"Description": "The spacing between points in the output path

Name: path_integration_step
"Description": "The discretization step along the global path. Lower values will give more accurate calculations but be slower."

Name: dilation_factor
"Description": "The number of cells to expand around each obstacle. Provides a safety buffer around obstacles."

Name: trim_path
"Description": "Reduce the length of the global path to only include points near the vehicle."

Name: display
"Description": "Display the map and calculated paths in an Xwindow."

Name: rate
"Description": "The rate in Hz at which the calculation will run."

Name: w_c
"Description": "The comfort weight for the path cost."

Name: w_s
"Description": "The static safety weight for the path cost."

Name: w_d
"Description": "The dynamic safety weight for the path cost."

Name: w_r
column4: "The path deviation weight for the path cost."
